title: The presentation of Resolution No. 137-38 (COR) “Relative to recognizing the observance of the Thirty-first (31st) Year Anniversary of the “Martin Luther King, Jr. (MLK) Day of Service” celebration; and commending the Serve Guam Commission and the AmeriCorps programs in Guam, and the various groups and individuals, for their continued commitment and dedication in their service to our island community.” will take place on Monday, January 19, 2026 at 11:00 AM and will be held at the Micronesia Mall, Center Court. We look forward to your attendance and participation. 1/16/2026 9:06 A.M. (FN)
